title: Quietly Quintessential French Beef Fillet Madeleine
description: A savory French dish featuring beef fillet, made in a madeleine form and served on a wooden board, perfect for a lazy Sunday lunch. This pescatarian-friendly dish has a unique tadka flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef fillet with salt, black pepper, and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the beef fillet until browned on all sides.
Transfer the beef fillet to a madeleine mold and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the butter and cook until melted, then add the sliced onion and cook until caramelized.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Sprinkle the flour over the onion mixture and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the shredded gruyere cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and smooth.
Pour the cheese mixture over the beef fillet in the madeleine mold.
Bake the madeleine in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until the beef is cooked to 130 degrees Fahrenheit for medium-rare.
